preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input text.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == '' or (line.split()[0].isalnum() or any(c in line.split()[0] for c in '_-.+')) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Package names consist of allowed characters (alphanumeric, underscore, minus, period, plus) and are non-whitespace.
The input contains multiple test cases ending with n=0, where each case has n packages with dependencies among themselves.

postconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]) > 0
postconditions.description: The output contains at least one line of text for the test cases.

postconditions.expression: all('cannot be ordered' in block or (len(block.splitlines()) == n and all(dep in installed_before[pkg] for pkg, deps in packages.items() for dep in deps)) for block, n, packages in zip(stdout.split('\n\n'), [14, 3], [{'libattr': [], 'vim-X11': ['vim-common', 'gtk2', 'libattr'], 'vim-common': [], 'gtk2': ['libtiff', 'atk', 'pango', 'glib2'], 'libtiff': ['zlib', 'libjpeg'], 'atk': [], 'pango': ['xorg-x11-libs', 'freetype', 'glib2'], 'glib2': [], 'zlib': [], 'libjpeg': [], 'xorg-x11-libs': ['grep', 'freetype'], 'grep': ['pcre'], 'pcre': [], 'freetype': []}, {'emacs': ['xorg-x11', 'lisp'], 'xorg-x11': [], 'lisp': ['emacs']}]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output block either states 'cannot be ordered' if a cycle exists, or lists all n packages in an order where every package appears after all its dependencies.

postconditions.expression: all(block.splitlines() == sorted(block.splitlines(), key=lambda x: x) for block in stdout.split('\n\n') if 'cannot be ordered' not in block)
postconditions.description: When a valid ordering exists, the output order is lexicographically first among all valid topological sorts.

postconditions.expression: stdout.count('\n\n') == max(0, len([line for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip().isdigit()]) - 1)
postconditions.description: A blank line separates the output blocks of consecutive test cases.
